requirements.description: Review exact package, operating and absolute limits, voltage/current polarity and temperature.
Review exact land patterns, all power/thermal contacts, gate loops and manufacturer layout.
Review actual peak/RMS current, copper, contacts, dissipation and fault-energy/SOA.
Validate startup, prebias, reverse input, disconnect and faults with actual parasitics; model gaps remain open.
Measure electrical/thermal behavior and failure response over actual operating extremes before release.

notes: 20V VDS, +/-8V VGS. 13.5mOhm maximum at1.8V is specified at25C/4A with <=300us/2% pulse test; this is not a guaranteed 9A continuous result. Evaluate actual hot pulse resistance, gate drive, SOA and thermal copper. Package current headline and transient thermal rating do not establish board current capacity. All source/drain lands need external copper; no internal-pad exemptions.
